＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿００１Cousiiiiin!!
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿００２I spotted you from behind,￥so I chased after you.
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿００３I mean, we never get￥a chance to really talk,￥Cousin!
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿００４Let's chat for a bit, okay?
I wanted to talk too.
Hmm, if I have to...
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿００５Yay!￥That's my cousin!!
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿００６I'm so glad￥you're a candidate too, Cousin.
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿００７Good thing I caught you!￥Ever since I got here, I've been￥wanting to talk to you, Cousin!
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿００８That's so mean!!￥What's wrong with that?!￥It's been eight years!＝＠１２１＿００９Before I moved away, you always￥listened to me and said￥"there, there"!
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿０１０Ever since we met up here,￥I've been wanting to￥talk to you, Cousin.
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿０１１You know...￥I was actually really nervous!
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿０１２This project is supposedly top￥secret, so I couldn't even tell￥my friends I'd been chosen.
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿０１３I know it's an important￥mission, but having to come all￥the way here and take tests...
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿０１４I'm so relieved￥to have someone I know here...＝＠１２１＿０１５And on top of that...
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿０１６...it's my dearly beloved￥Cousin!
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿０１７Oh... sorry.￥Am I talking too much?
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿０１８Was I being annoying...?
No, not at all.
You're a bit hyper.
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿０１９Phew!￥I've wanted to see you for￥so long, I was just so happy...
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿０２０I was scared you'd hate me￥for getting so worked up,￥Cousin!
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿０２１Oh... I-I'm sorry.￥I was so happy to see you￥that I got carried away...
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿０２２I haven't changed a bit￥that way since we were kids...＝＠１２１＿０２３I should work on that.
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿０２４Sorry, Cousin.
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿０２５Talking like this, it feels like￥we're little kids again.
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿０２６Hey, Cousin!￥I heard the latest data on Elan￥just came into the Monitor Room!
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿０２７Since we have the chance,￥want to go see it together?
Sure, let's go together.
Sorry, I'll pass.
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿０２８Yay!￥Then let's hurry!
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿０２９Actually, I've never properly￥seen footage of Elan!
＊Kaname＊＠１２１＿０３０I can't wait!
＊Kaname＊＠１２２＿００１Whoa! So cold!!￥Turning down an invitation from￥a cousin as cute as me!
＊Kaname＊＠１２２＿００２But it's a rare chance,￥so let's go see it.
＊Kaname＊＠１２２＿００３Please! Pretty please?
＊Kaname＊＠１２２＿００４Come on!! Let's go, let's go!!
－　Monitor Room　－＝－　No one is here　－
＊Kaname＊＠１２２＿００５Looks like nobody else is here.
＊Kaname＊＠１２２＿００６Uh... um, this is...｝￥＠１２２＿００７Hmm... the controls are tough...
＊Kaname＊＠１２２＿００８Cousin! I want to see it on￥the big screen, so work the￥controls for me!

＊Kaname＊＠１２２＿００９Wow... it's beautiful...＝＠１２２＿０１０Such a...￥beautiful blue planet.＝＠１２２＿０１１It's so much bluer and prettier￥than Earth in the old footage...＝＠１２２＿０１２We were chosen￥to go to this planet.＝＠１２２＿０１３They say Elan has an environment￥really similar to Earth's...
About Elan...
About Earth...
＊Kaname＊＠１２２＿０１４Elan is the "star of hope" for￥a humanity that lost Earth.＝＠１２２＿０１５Whether people can settle on￥Elan for good... we're the key￥to that, aren't we?
＊Kaname＊＠１２２＿０１６Heh, not my words, though!￥I got all of that￥from Narusawa!
＊Kaname＊＠１２２＿０１７Anyway, out of the nine￥candidates here, only two￥get to go to Elan.

＊Kaname＊＠１２２＿０１８Earth...￥Long ago, it was a beautiful￥blue planet like this too...＝＠１２２＿０１９And now it's a dead planet￥where not even microbes￥can survive...＝＠１２２＿０２０A planet we humans￥destroyed ourselves...＝＠１２２＿０２１Elan is the last hope given￥to sinful humanity...
＊Kaname＊＠１２２＿０２２Heh, not my words, though!￥I got all of that from the￥training textbook.
＊Kaname＊＠１２２＿０２３I don't really get all￥that ancient history stuff...
＊Kaname＊＠１２２＿０２４Anyway!＝＠１２２＿０２５If we candidates qualify,￥we get to go to Elan as a pair,￥right?
＊Kaname＊＠１２３＿００１If I were with you, Cousin,￥I bet Elan would be fun.
＊Kaname＊＠１２３＿００２I mean, it'd be just the two of￥us, right? Kinda romantic, huh!
＊Kaname＊＠１２３＿００３So that I won't hold you back￥when that time comes...
＊Kaname＊＠１２３＿００４I've gotta work hard!!
Let's both do our best.
Nothing's decided yet.
＊Kaname＊＠１２３＿００５Yeah! I'll do my best!!
＊Kaname＊＠１２３＿００６Being with you is my number￥one reason for wanting￥to go to Elan!
＊Kaname＊＠１２３＿００７I know that already!
＊Kaname＊＠１２３＿００８But if you don't even want to￥go, you won't make it even when￥you could have!
＊Kaname＊＠１２３＿００９It all starts with how you feel!
＊Kaname＊＠１２３＿０１０Back when I became a candidate,￥I had no confidence in myself￥and was really nervous...
＊Kaname＊＠１２３＿０１１This project is about￥humanity's future, after all...
＊Kaname＊＠１２３＿０１２I wondered if an ordinary girl￥like me should really be chosen￥for such an important role...
＊Kaname＊＠１２３＿０１３But hey, I did get chosen!
＊Kaname＊＠１２３＿０１４So I'm going to try￥as hard as I can!
